limitations: The 1,621 related-object authority list was deliberately not traversed because it is broad and unrelated to the locality-bounded scope.

The 40 retained locality authority routes total 273 memberships but 248 unique URLs; they are one-page retained observations and do not prove every BM locality authority was found. Orongo was retained separately.

Search captures are card-level evidence. Exact visible Producer name field supports maker attribution, but does not replace detail-page review of date, description, image subject, or source suitability.
The 75-record representation review and current collection overlap are URL/museum-number deduplications. A result absent from those sets is a candidate for review, not an approved source or object.
Names such as “Hotu Matua” and “Easter Island” are copied from the catalogue production-place field and may be broad, ambiguous, or person/site labels; preserve them as attributed metadata.
A34/A35 accession-series membership is only a discovery cross-check; it is not proof of Schlosser authorship.
